tool_args.rationale: The maximum pilot gradient is 2.44, below the reported critical range of approximately 2.50–2.68. The high-gradient probe directly tests whether an avalanche downturn occurs and identifies its parameters.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the avalanche law to the pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All pilot gradients are below the stated critical range, so the avalanche threshold and strength are not identifiable.
The pilot’s concave trend does not distinguish these from a thresholded avalanche mechanism at higher gradients.
The ambiguity is the high-gradient regime, not temporal resolution.
It does not resolve the relevant threshold ambiguity.
